Local, Trusted, and Experience Engineers

What is Heatspan about?

Serving Brooklyn & Queens since 1982. Heatspan practices the art of Steam and Hot water heating on a daily basis for the past 45 Years. Heatspan calibrates, synchronizing, and balances steam and hot water systems for comfort & fuel efficiency.

More Than 40 Years of Local Service

For over 40 years, the team at Heatspan has been repairing and maintaining heating and cooling equipment throughout Brooklyn, Queens, and the surrounding areas.

We're a small, local business focused on helping customers stay comfortable without hidden fees or surprise upsells. Our team offers Spanish-language support, same-day service availability, and is fully licensed and insured.
